When to use: When a session delivers a series of explicit corrections to previously stored environment/config facts (e.g. 'Update for lesson N: ...').
Steps:
1. Match each update to the existing memory item it contradicts by topic (host, model, window, owner, limit, region).
2. Supersede the old item with the new value rather than adding a parallel note, so only one current value exists per topic.
3. Preserve the prior value in parentheses when it aids context (e.g. 'previously team Atlas').
4. Record the operator's sentence verbatim as evidence and set confidence high for direct statements.
5. Re-index affected topic pages so links point at the current values.

Primary analytics warehouse is in eu-central-1 (migrated from us-east-1).

Evidence: “Primary analytics warehouse was migrated to eu-central-1.”

Enterprise API rate limit is 2000 requests per minute (raised from 500).

Evidence: “Enterprise API rate limit was raised to 2000 requests per minute.”

Billing service on-call owner is team Beacon (previously team Atlas).

Evidence: “Billing service on-call ownership moved from team Atlas to team Beacon.”

Deploy freeze runs Friday 16:00 to 18:00 UTC (previously 12:00-14:00 UTC).

Evidence: “The deploy freeze window is now Friday 16:00 to 18:00 UTC.”

Batch summarization uses model-summarizer-v3 (upgraded from v1).

Evidence: “We upgraded batch summarization to model-summarizer-v3 last week.”

Staging database host is db2.internal (moved from db1.internal after the migration).

Evidence: “The staging database moved to db2.internal after the migration.”
Deploy freeze window is Friday 16:00-18:00 UTC; schedule risky releases outside it. Billing service on-call is owned by team Beacon (was team Atlas) — route billing escalations there.

Canonical environment facts, kept current via supersede rather than append. Regions: primary analytics warehouse in eu-central-1. Databases: staging host db1.internal -> db2.internal after migration. Models: batch summarization on model-summarizer-v3. Limits: Enterprise API 2000 req/min. Ownership: billing service on-call = team Beacon. Process: deploy freeze Friday 16:00-18:00 UTC. When any of these change, supersede the existing note instead of adding a second one.
Primary analytics warehouse is in eu-central-1 (migrated from us-east-1).
Enterprise API rate limit is 2000 requests per minute (raised from 500).
Billing service on-call owner is team Beacon (previously team Atlas).
Deploy freeze runs Friday 16:00 to 18:00 UTC (previously 12:00-14:00 UTC).
Batch summarization uses model-summarizer-v3 (upgraded from v1).
Staging database host is db2.internal (moved from db1.internal after the migration).

Environment facts in this workspace are revised frequently and arrive as batched 'lesson N' updates; treat any stored infra/config fact as potentially stale and prefer the most recent explicit operator statement.

Basis: All six stored facts were contradicted by a single session of sequential 'Update for lesson N' messages.
